req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-002 requires HTTP 422 when the title field is missing from POST /tasks/. The schema enforces title as required (min_length=1, max_length=100). Tests cover: (1) positive path — valid title yields 201, (2) negative path — missing title yields 422, (3) boundary — empty string title ('') yields 422 (min_length=1 boundary), (4) boundary — single-char title yields 201 (min_length=1 lower bound passes), (5) decision-table — null title yields 422. Mutation resilience: exact status codes (201 vs 422), exact response field checks, both sides of the min_length=1 boundary tested.

trace: R-TASK-002: positive equivalence partition — valid title accepted
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import os, sys

os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r_task_002_pos.db')

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_valid_title_returns_201():
    payload = {"title": "Buy milk", "description": "From the store", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy milk"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert "created_at" in body

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_missing_title_returns_422():
    payload = {"description": "No title here", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    fields = [err["loc"] for err in body["detail"]]
    title_mentioned = any("title" in loc for loc in fields)
    assert title_mentioned == True
